notes: 812 PM PA CHECKLIST DOES NOT EXIST on this sheet. See templates[].notFoundEvidence for the 812 entry. Only 8 of the 9 requested templates were extractable.
EVERY inferredType is a GUESS derived from the rendered answer text in completed PDFs. Connecteam's real field types were never read. Verify all of them before building templates.

inferredType 'TASK_CHECKBOX' is NOT in the type vocabulary the task specified. It was added deliberately: ~6-22 items per template render as a bare line with no answer value at all, which is the signature of a Connecteam task/checkbox item, not free text. Labelling them 'TEXT' (the specified fallback) would have been actively misleading for a rebuild. Treat it as 'bare item, no captured value - probably a checkbox'.

SAMPLING FOUND NO VARIANCE. 3 samples per template, different days and (mostly) different submitters, produced identical question sets in every case - seenInSamples === ofSamples for all 174 questions. The likely reason is that these Connecteam PDFs render the FULL question set including unanswered items, not just answered ones. That makes the extraction more trustworthy than the brief assumed, but it also means sampling did NOT prove the absence of conditional/branching questions - it only showed the PDF renderer does not hide them.

CHECKPOINT items carry repeatedTimesInPdf: 3. Each CHECKPOINT prompt is printed three times in a row in every PDF, matching the section header '(Take picture of EACH checkpoint every 7PM, 10PM and END OF SHIFT)'. UNRESOLVED: this is either ONE photo question that accepts 3 photos, or THREE separate questions. The PDF cannot distinguish them. Decide against Connecteam itself before building.

4645 PM PA Checklist genuinely OMITS the 'Transforming Spaces' section (Before photo / After photo / Notes/Comments). Verified by grep across all 3 samples: 0 occurrences, while all other templates have exactly 1. This is a real template difference at Lakeland, not a parsing artifact. 19 questions vs 22 elsewhere.
The CHECKPOINT section header is a multi-line centered block in the PDF and was reassembled programmatically. Its canonical text is the same in all 7 PM templates.
All prompts are bilingual EN / ES separated by ' / ', already matching ADR-013's bilingual field-staff requirement. Spanish is the operators' existing wording - reuse it rather than re-translating.

Prompts were reassembled from wrapped PDF lines using heuristics (lowercase-start continuation, trailing-hyphen continuation). Long prompts are the most likely place for a join error. Spot-check items 3, 11 and 21 of AM PA Checklist and item 6 of every PM template.
'Notes/Comments' renders as 'Notes/Comments::' in the PDF (double colon). The trailing colons were stripped from the prompt.

sampleAnswer is the first non-empty answer found across the samples and is illustrative only - it is one worker's response on one day, not an allowed-value list. No SINGLE-choice type was assigned anywhere because no question produced a small closed set of non-Yes/No answers.

FILENAME DATE IS ONE DAY BEHIND. The file is named ...083126 as specified by the task, but this extraction ran on 2026-09-01 at 11:35 ET. Rename to ConnecteamTemplates_PA_RISE8_090126.json if the convention Title_PropertyID_MMDDYY is meant to carry the true Eastern date.
Smartsheet access was strictly read-only: list_attachments, search, get_attachment. No rows, comments or attachments were created, modified or deleted.
PDFs render page/media markers as 'n/NN' on their own lines; these were stripped and are not questions.
